record.question: '2017 Global Paragliding Contest' held during 17-21 December 2017 in the state of
record.explanation: Answer D: Sikkim. The reported 17–21 December 2017 competition was the Sikkim Red Panda International Paragliding Accuracy Open at Gangtok. The contemporary report directly attributes the schedule to Sikkim Paragliding Association spokesperson Manoj Chettri. Historical/source note: Evidence is the original attributed organizer announcement reported by the press; an archived organizer result sheet was not located. This identifies the announced venue, without asserting the event actually ran on every scheduled day. Reference: https://www.oneindia.com/india/sikkim-to-hold-international-paragliding-competition-in-december-2584030.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
